B4D Innovations for Peace - Emprender Paz

description.narrative: Insats som syftar till att bidra till fredsbyggande i Colombia genom att engagera och mobilisera privata sektorn för inclusive sustainable business. Avtalspart: GIZ. Tre komponenter: 1) skapa och genomföra en ny challenge fund Innovations for Peace, 2) skala upp existerande Emprender Paz-pris, 3) stärka lokala partners kapacitet och ägarskap med sikte på lokalt övertagande 2015.

Intervention aiming to contribute to peace-building in Colombia through engagement and mobilization of the private sector for inclusive sustainable business. Agreement partner:GIZ. 3 components: 1) create and implement a new challenge fund Innovations for Peace, 2) scale up existing Emprender Paz award, 3) strengthen local partners' capacity and ownership with a view to local takeover 2015.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative:
General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: By the end of 2015, the three proposed objectives were achieved: First, the Emprender Paz prize has awarded a total of 32 private initiatives (four each year) from 424 nominates from different sectors and sizes (50% big companies, 47% medium sized companies and 3% small sized companies). These initiatives have directly benefited more than 18500 people that have been affected by the armed conflict and indirectly more than 73000 people of 26 Colombian regions. In addition, more than 20% of the awarded initiatives have been replicated.
Second, the external evaluation made in 2015 for the “Innovations for peace Fund”, showed the positive impact through the support to15 innovative business models. The Fund leveraged 150% of the Swedish contribution with private resources and benefited more than 1200 families in rural areas affected by the conflict with social, economic, environmental sustainable business models.
Finally, the Corporation Emprender Paz was created as non-profit organization, recognized as a legal entity by the chamber of Commerce of Bogota on September 10, 2014. The commitment of the local partner Fundacion Social to create and support this organization show sustainability in the long run.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
